stdout:
usage: agent-config council [-h]
                            {estimate,run,debate,render,replay,quota,shadow-report}
                            ...

Non-interactive council orchestration.

positional arguments:
  {estimate,run,debate,render,replay,quota,shadow-report}
    estimate            Pre-call cost preview (no spend).
    run                 Run the council; --confirm required to spend.
    debate              Multi-round debate with progressive cost disclosure
                        (Phase 7).
    render              Re-render a saved responses JSON.
    replay              Re-render decision-replay.md from a saved responses
                        JSON (Phase 9).
    quota               Dump today's CLI-quota state and configured caps
                        (step-8 P1).
    shadow-report       Read agents/runtime/council/shadow-log.jsonl and print
                        the 7-day rolling disagreement rate + SLO status
                        (step-9 P10).

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
